receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt in 'A Shilling Cookery for The People' by Alexis Soyer (Soyer 1845);
receipts.receiptText: 252. Chicken Pudding.- Cut one into eight pieces, half a pound of bacon, cut into slices; season with one teaspoonful of salt, half of pepper, two of chopped parsley, a little thyme, and one captain's biscuit, well broken; fill the pudding with the meat, add half a pint of milk, boil for one hour and a half; serve with Butter Sauce over, and chopped parsley on the top.
